Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT image 4 (the current attack/W06 candidate) to fix ONE pose problem. Image 1 W and image 2 E are original Zhuling identity references; image 3 is principal confirmed hand-painted style only. Single frame, one bird, true transparent background, 1024 square, same full-body framing and position.
CRITICAL CHANGE: The large wing presently pointing to upper-right in image 4 is the anatomical RIGHT, NEAR wing. REMOVE that upright upper-right wing pose and redraw the SAME single wing rotated forward at its same screen-right shoulder. The wing upper-arm should angle LEFTWARD across the bird's upper back toward upper-left, with an obviously BENT ELBOW near the right cheek; the distal fan sweeps FORWARD toward upper-left, partly obscured by the head due to rear camera. Upper-right quadrant should now be mostly transparent because that wing has swung away. The visible near-wing fan must be compact and foreshortened, not a huge upper-right V wing. The OTHER wing on screen-left stays spread upward to balance. Exactly TWO wings total, no added third wing.
Keep rear-right view and entire back facing camera, short fan tail down-right, both feet under body, indigo copper-red feathers, amber cloud crown, ivory scarf, celadon neck pendant fixed in existing side-back location. Extend head a little toward upper-left for short peck. No chest-facing turn, no mirrored image, no fire, no long tail, no effects, no UI, no text. Clearly show the near right wing now accelerating forward for attack.
